principles.history_use: Historical pattern match may increase classification confidence but never overrides a failed hard gate.
principles.break_rule: Structural break requires a later closed-bar close beyond the relevant level; wick-only penetration is not a confirmed break.
principles.no_line_rule: After an active TL breaks, do not create the next TL until valid pivots, anchors, Dow/N structure and required break evidence exist.
principles.cross_tf_rule: source_tf and owner/display_tf are separate concepts; lower-timeframe structure may be displayed on a higher timeframe only when ownership evidence supports it.

teacher_cases.use: Regression baseline; validated lines should remain GOOD after auditor changes.
Detect selection of an inner TL when an important outer structure should own the line.
Detect the transition state after old-TL break and before the next structural TL is ready.

patterns.name: NORMAL_MAJOR_TL
patterns.meaning: Large/Mid TL has valid pivots, anchors, HL/N/Dow evidence and closed-bar break confirmation.

patterns.name: OUTER_TL_PREFERRED
patterns.meaning: Important outer structure is selected instead of a weaker inner anchor pair.

promotion_policy.stage_1: Audit and log only. Never rewrite Candidate, Selector, Lifecycle or Renderer state.
promotion_policy.stage_2: Only after stable regression: BAD -> cause -> candidate/selector reevaluation -> re-audit.
